sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The soul's primary purpose is to make the world a dwelling place for G-d, and fulfilling this mission elevates the soul incomparably more than any lofty revelations.

translations.translation: Now, since the intention of the soul's descent below is to make the world a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
it is therefore understood
that this matter
(making the dwelling place for Him, blessed be He)
is a primary matter in its standing and condition.
For when it does not fulfill its mission and function, G-d forbid,
even if it has the most sublime revelations,
the essential thing is lacking.
And on the other hand,
by fulfilling the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms,
a great and wondrous elevation beyond measure is effected within it.

Based on this, it will be understood that the service of the "Mem-Hei" (the hundred), through which the revelation of Mah is effected, is the hundred blessings that pertain to the refinement and purification of the world
(as will be explained),
even though the revelation could seemingly also be achieved through service in the particular powers of the soul,
to walk in all His ways, etc.,
for the perfection of the soul,
even the Mah within it,
is specifically through fulfilling its function and mission.
And this is "And now, Israel, what [does the L-rd your G-d ask of you?],"
that through the Mah of the soul, he performs the service of Israel
(subjugation of the sitra achra and transformation of the sitra achra)
"now,"
for through this he fulfills the intention for which he was created,
specifically through this,
it is the ultimate elevation
(also)
of the Mah within him.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: A person is obligated to recite one hundred blessings daily to draw down Divine revelation from the concealed world to the revealed world, especially to the lower worlds.

translations.translation: And this is [the meaning of] "A person is obligated to recite one hundred blessings every day,"
for the matter of blessings is that there should be a drawing down of the revelation of G-dliness not only to Israel, but that through them, the revelation of G-dliness will be drawn into the world.
And as we say in the formulation of the blessings, "Blessed are You, L-rd our G-d, King of the world,"
that there should be drawn
(Blessed)
the revelation of Havayah to Israel,
"our G-d,"
and through this, the revelation will be drawn into the world,
"King of the world."
And within the worlds themselves,
the drawing down through the blessings is
(primarily)
to the lower worlds.
And as it is stated,
"Blessed be the L-rd, G-d of Israel, from the world and until the world,"
that it should be drawn from the concealed world to the revealed world.
For the "concealed world"
refers to the upper worlds, which are nullified to G-dliness,
like fish in the sea that are covered and nullified to the water,
and the "revealed world" refers to the lower worlds,
and particularly this physical world,
which appears as an independent entity and separate thing,
and the matter of the blessing is that the revelation of G-dliness should be drawn also into the lower worlds, even into this physical world.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The hundred blessings correspond to drawing the multitude of lights from the concealed world into the vessels of the revealed world, encompassing all details of creation.

translations.translation: And since everything that the Holy One, blessed be He, created in His world, He did not create a single thing in vain,
and everything that the Holy One, blessed be He, created in His world, He created only for His glory,
it is necessary to draw the revelation of G-dliness into every thing in the world,
so that it will be felt within it in a revealed way that it was created for His glory, blessed be He.
And this is the matter of the hundred blessings,
for "hundred" is the greatest multitude
[as is known,
that the totality of letters are in three categories: units, tens, and hundreds],
for multitude refers to particulars,
and the matter of the hundred blessings is that the revelation of G-dliness should be drawn into all the particulars of the world.
And one may add to this based on what is known
regarding the matter of the numbers: units, tens, hundreds,
that sometimes it is explained
that the larger number is above,
and the more it is drawn downward,
the number diminishes
(hundreds in Keter and units in Malchus).
And sometimes it is explained
that above is the number of units,
and the more it is drawn downward,
the number increases
(units in Keter and hundreds in Malchus).
And the explanation of this is known,
that these two modes are in lights and vessels.
For in lights,
the larger number is above,
and in vessels, the larger number is below.
Based on this, one may add explanation regarding the number of one hundred blessings,
for among the distinctions between the concealed world and the revealed world is
that in the concealed world, the primary aspect is the lights, and in the revealed world, the primary aspect is the vessels,
and since the matter of the blessings is the drawing down from the concealed world to the revealed world
(as above),
meaning that the matters of the concealed world
(lights)
should be revealed also in the revealed world
(vessels),
therefore one must recite one hundred blessings,
to draw the multitude of lights of the concealed world into the vessels of the revealed world.
And this extends until it is drawn into the multitude of creations of this physical world,
for the matter of "How great are Your works, O L-rd"
(the division into a multitude of particulars)
is primarily specifically in this physical world.
